Ue.bar_b_note: Warm torch-lit hall with real value range and two solid creatures in A carries it, but the white puff-ring telegraph, text-led tells and (in B) a missing player creature keep it below a shipping fight.

Mo.bar_b_note: The gold spider reads, but murky low-value forest, flat magenta floor shapes as telegraphs, a near-invisible player creature and (A i11/i13/i15) canopy filling the frame sink it; no storm sky or lightning mood reads.

Gk.bar_b_note: A's aftermaths are site-specific (freed villager by an open cage, smoking collapsed camp, banners down) but smeared low-res ground, sparse even scatter and flat walls sit far below Palworld density and Valheim light.

Ik.bar_b_note: Standing Tanglevolt matches the owner bar in silhouette and scale, but A's faint poses float above their shadow with the lightning material washing out to black-and-white, and B's faint end tips the wolf nose-down near vertical.

Ij.bar_b_note: Warm meadow grass, a tree line and two solid naturalistic creatures come close, but the screen-wide dust-puff ring (A f04-f08), flat gold disc markers on the target and soft featureless ground keep it short of shipping finish.

Rn.bar_b_note: Dusk stronghold sky and the colourful bird and white wolf are appealing, but a dark, empty courtyard floor, puff-ring telegraphs, a stray winged creature hovering at frame edge (A 25527/26787) and B's camera jammed into the bird with speed-line streaks (27750) sink it.

Pe.bar_b_note: Purple storm sky, rain, glass shards and the rim-lit gold Voltarach carry the Stormwood mood, but the player's Sparkit is a speck under the spider and the moss floor is a uniform dark carpet.

Pf.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with readable eyes and a natural green-brown palette at a finish a shipping game would accept, though its rounded animated-film face is softer than the naturalistic creature bar.

Ge.bar_b_note: Pale dunes and the barnacled Cannonback suit Tidewake, but the player's Ripplet is a ghost in A and absent in B, flat disc markers sit on the turtle's shell, and there is no water, sky or fog to give depth.

top_changes.change: Make the player's creature always present: opaque, full scale and framed by the combat camera alongside the opponent (Ge, Pe, Ue B, Rn, Mo), with a camera rule that stops it pushing inside a creature (Rn B 27750) or behind canopy (Mo A).

Replace telegraph and hit language (white puff rings, flat gold/blue discs on the target, flat magenta floor shapes, speed-line streaks) with grounded element effects: real stones, dust, water and lightning that strike at the target's feet, with a body stagger instead of a text label.

Give the ground and lighting form: crisp tiled grass, moss and sand materials, clustered groves and props instead of even scatter, plus sky, fog and a time-of-day grade that separates foreground, midground and distance (Gk, Ge, Mo, Rn).
